notes: Every name, description and grade below was checked against Exophase (descriptions), GTAVice and KeenGamer (names + grades). Nothing was invented; where a method is not yet established, the guide says so.

Name spelling: 'Vice Got a Price!' follows KeenGamer/gtavibes (GTAVice image text shows it without the exclamation mark). 'Tits Ass Drug Money' is the uncensored name shown in GTAVice's trophy image text; the site's headings censor it as 'T**s Ass Drug Money'.

Gamerscore per trophy is NOT included: GTAVice's per-trophy values sum to more than the confirmed 1,000G Xbox total, so they are unreliable. The grade breakdown (1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze) is confirmed by all sources.

Hidden-trophy status per trophy is NOT included: sources disagree on the hidden count (28 per u7buy/gtavibes vs 15 per gtasix.how) and no fetched source labels each trophy hidden/visible. Treat story trophies as hidden until the app verifies against a tracker that exposes the flag.

Only one trophy is potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude (first meditation in Chapter 1). Everything else can be done in free roam after the story. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter. Cheats disable trophies and saving while active.

Guides are written in our own words. Where a method comes from KeenGamer or GTAVice it is cited in guideSources; where sources say the method is still unconfirmed, methodConfirmed is false and the guide says so plainly.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 PS5 Trophies Revealed (18 Nov 2026)
sources.usedFor: Confirms the Exophase list went public on 18 Nov 2026 with 55 trophies including a Platinum, and that A Long Road requires 100% completion.

trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it unlocks automatically the moment you have earned the other 54 trophies, so there is nothing separate to do for it. In practice it pops last, usually right after A Long Road (100% completion) or your final cleanup trophy. Just track the other 54 in this guide and it takes care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing at the start of the game and the trophy unlocks when it ends. It is most players' first trophy.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before you leave the chapter — that is the one thing in the whole game that can be missed.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play through all of Chapter 2's missions; it unlocks when the chapter closes. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3 in full and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Keep working on side activities as they appear, but nothing extra is required for this one.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Finish Chapter 4 and it unlocks. Note that the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' opens up the bank vault robberies during this chapter, which you will need later for Maximum Withdrawal and for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy and one of only two Golds. Complete the final story mission in Chapter 5 and it unlocks. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida in free roam, so nothing is cut off by finishing the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story and the trophy unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist and it pops at the end of the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play and the trophy unlocks when it finishes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners and it unlocks at the mission's end.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown (set around Vice City International Airport) and the trophy pops when it ends.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The second Gold and the longest grind in the game — budget roughly 100 hours after the story. Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion in-game and work through its checklist; you do NOT have to do everything in the game, only the listed amounts. The checklist includes: all story chapters, 100 optional tasks, robberies (39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, plus fencing totals of $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 Marked Bills and $200,000 vehicles), collectibles (15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 50 of 66 weapons, 100 of 255 animals studied), and activities (30 of 40 races won, 42 of 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 of 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 15 of 15 Bret Target Decks). Track it in the menu and stop each activity once its number is met.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses, airtime and other stunt types, tracked in your stats. The 100% checklist needs 300 of 397 stunts, so this trophy pops on the way to A Long Road. Hunt for stunt jumps and ramps as you travel rather than grinding them all at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, pool, mini golf, basketball, bowling and drone races are the kinds of activities on offer. Just sample each one as you come across it in Leonida and the trophy pops after the ninth.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit shooting ranges around Leonida, learn each challenge's target layout and time limit, and replay until you hit the gold score. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so this is a mandatory part of the Platinum road, not a detour.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations around Leonida. Fly the drone through the course gates as fast as you can and beat the target time at every site. The 100% checklist separately needs all 42 Drone Time Trials, so keep racing after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — road, off-road, boat, air or any other race type, as long as each one is a different race event. You need 30 of 40 race wins for 100% completion, so this pops well before the checklist is done. Enter races from the map and replay any you lose.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing challenges reward the better catch, so use the best bait and rod you have and aim for the biggest fish of the session. This is a one-off duel, not a grind.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade game in Leonida through to completion — finish a full game rather than just starting one. There are four arcade games in total and the 100% checklist asks you to play all four, so try the rest after this pops.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's side-mission strand to its end and complete his final mission. Character questlines unlock as you progress through the story; keep checking the map for Andy's icon and work through his jobs in order.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Kenton is also tied to the treasure sets collectible, so his jobs are worth doing as they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's side missions until his final mission, then complete it. Like the other character strands, his missions appear as you move through the story — clear them when they show up rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight Strangers & Freaks mission strands — the odd jobs and encounters handed out by strangers across Leonida. These are the blue stranger icons on the map; finish a whole strand (all of that stranger's missions), not just one job, and repeat for eight different strangers.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Check the map for Randy's marker as the story opens up new areas and clear his jobs in order.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. His jobs unlock alongside story progress, so keep an eye on the map for his icon.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — read this first. There are 18 meditation spots. The first is with Lucia on Jason's balcony in the morning after the mission Down to Earth, when she mentions meditating — accept her invitation and complete that balcony meditation BEFORE leaving Chapter 1, or the set may be uncompletable. After that, find and meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida. Note the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy needs all 18, so keep going after 15.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt down a unique animal for Bret — a specific target animal he asks you to track, not just any wildlife. Use your binoculars to study animals and follow Bret's hunting jobs; completing his Target Decks (15 of 15 for 100%) runs alongside this.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collect trading cards around Leonida and complete three full sets. Cards are hidden across the map and in shops; the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so three sets is only the start — keep collecting after this pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations across Leonida — vehicles, landmarks and points of interest all count. Open WAiNK whenever you see an unfamiliar vehicle or place and scan it; start early and it builds up naturally as you travel. The 100% checklist needs 100 WAiNK scans too, so this is fully on the Platinum road.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges — the assorted feats listed in the Challenges menu (driving, combat, exploration and more). Pick the easy ones first and let the total build up through normal play; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so you will pass 50 on the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside you (Jason and Lucia together), raise your Wanted Level to four stars, then lose the cops and escape. Use a fast car, break line of sight, and hide until the stars clear — getting caught or killed resets the attempt. Do it in open country where you can outrun the search.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without your Wanted Level clearing in between — keep the heat on the whole run. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them quickly one after another, and do not wait around or hide long enough for the stars to drop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida — driving, parking near or scanning a new vehicle counts it as discovered. Use the WAiNK app on anything unfamiliar and vary the cars, bikes, boats and aircraft you take. The 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, so this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (the slow-motion targeting mode) and take down five enemies before it ends. Set it up where enemies are grouped — a gang hideout or a shootout with several attackers — and chain your shots while time is slowed. If you run out of targets, retry in a busier fight.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off in it — the 'unscheduled departure'. Get airside at VCIA, board a plane on the runway or at a gate, and get airborne before security stops you. Expect a Wanted Level; a fast approach and a quick takeoff work best.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhinos are guarded at military sites, so expect a heavy response — grab one, then use its cannon in a fight to register the trophy. A Wanted Level is part of the fun here.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected — no alarms, no one spotting you. Go in quiet, move slowly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; the trophy needs a clean run.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. There are eight vaults in total and all eight are needed for 100% completion. The vault robberies open up through the optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is...' in Chapter 4 — plan a fast escape vehicle and route before you go in, and get clear of the Wanted Level after each job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck out in the world and escape. Ambush one on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the Wanted Level that follows. Trucks run set routes, so watch the roads and pick a quiet stretch for the hit.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map, including the islands and the northern wilderness; the map fills in as you go, and the trophy pops once the last area is revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs in Leonida. Gang Operations are marked around the map; hit one per gang and the trophy unlocks. All 39 Gang Operations are needed for 100% completion, so this pops early in that grind.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED by any source we checked. The official description points to a bar overlooking Ocean Beach: go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and drink it with the view. The exact trigger (specific bar, time of day or seat) is still being confirmed by guide writers — try the obvious beachfront spots first and check back for a confirmed method rather than grinding blindly.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. The description describes a classic GTA-style exit: drive a vehicle through the front of a vehicle showroom and out the other side. Which showroom and what exactly counts as the 'classic style' exit is still being confirmed — a full-speed smash through the showroom glass is the natural reading, but do not treat that as verified until a guide confirms the exact trigger.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables there and escape with them. This is the method guide writers currently list for the trophy; it is early-days information (the game launched today), so if it does not pop, check for an updated method before repeating the run.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia — train and work out with each protagonist until both hit the top of the Strength stat. Gyms and strength-building activities raise it; switch between the two characters and train both rather than focusing on one.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the running tally of choices and crimes the game tracks. This builds up through ordinary play: crimes, jobs, robberies and story choices all feed it. There is no shortcut to name yet; just play normally and check your profile total as you go.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. This is a hidden trophy and no guide we checked has established how it unlocks — the description ('Second time's the charm') suggests retrying something after a first failure, but that is a guess, not a verified method. Do not grind for it blindly; wait for a confirmed method from the trophy community.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED. A hidden trophy with no established unlock method in any source we checked — the description reads like a reaction to a strange random encounter, and guide writers have not confirmed what triggers it. Likely tied to a rare world event or easter egg, but that is unconfirmed; wait for the community to pin it down rather than chasing rumours.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: METHOD NOT YET CONFIRMED in detail. The description calls for a melee drive-by: attack with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock targets over 'like bowling pins'. The precise setup (weapon, speed, target count) is still being confirmed by guide writers — the plain reading is to swing a melee weapon at pedestrians from a slow-moving car, but treat that as unverified until confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts wash them into clean cash. Keep fencing them as you earn them and the total adds up; $250,000 laundered is also one of the 100% completion fencing requirements, so it counts double.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — weapons, clothes, food, car mods and anything else you buy counts. This accumulates naturally through a full playthrough; if you are short at the end, buy expensive items (weapons and vehicle upgrades are the fastest way to close the gap).
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garage properties around Leonida. Garages cost serious money, so save up through robberies and fencing, then buy them one by one from the property listings. Owning them also gives you storage for your vehicle collection.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app on your phone. Find a vehicle you want to keep, open the app and register it — repeat for ten different vehicles. Stolen and bought vehicles both count as long as the app accepts the registration.
trophies.name: On the Spot
